devices.title: Samsung Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Buds3 Pro will soon work as hearing aids
devices.description: Back in the summer, Samsung's Hearing Aid feature for the Galaxy Buds got cleared by the FDA in the US. Today, the company announced that its Hearing Test and Hearing Aid features have also received medical device approval in South Korea, from the country's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS). devices.title: MacBook Neo Shipments Expected to Double in 2027
devices.description: Apple wants suppliers to make 16 million MacBook Neo laptops in 2027, or double the amount expected for this year, according to supply chain sources (via DigiTimes).
